question:
**Direction: Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

**__As long as he__** completes his work on time, I have no cause for worry.
solution:
The correct answer is **'****No improvement required.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given context,** 'as long as'** means** 'provided that'**. **('as long as' **का अर्थ है '**बशर्ते कि**')

 
 
• For Example - **As long as** you fed him, he would be cooperative.
 
 
 
• The given sentence means that provided that the man completes his work on time, his higher authority has no cause for worry. (दिए गए वाक्य का अर्थ है कि यदि व्यक्ति समय पर अपना काम पूरा कर लेता है, तो उसके उच्च अधिकारी को चिंता का कोई कारण नहीं है।)
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The past indefinite tense, also known as simple past tense, is used to indicate a finished or completed action/task that occurred/happened at a specific point in time in the past. 

 
 
• Structure: Subject + verb in the past form + . . . . . + adverb of time + . . . . .
 
• Example: *I ate a mango a few minutes ago.*
